title: E major open chord for beginners: fingering, strumming, and technique cues
summary: This JustinGuitar lesson teaches the E major open chord to beginners, focusing on exact finger placement (index on the G string 1st fret, middle on the A string 2nd fret, ring on the D string 2nd fret), and why the second finger sits slightly back from the fret to accommodate the third finger. It demonstrates strumming all six strings and introduces a strum–pickup–strum practice pattern, with options to use a thumb for picking notes. The video also covers thumb placement behind the neck to build muscle for barre chords, common beginner issues (muting, pressing too hard, and proper finger-tip contact), string-by-string troubleshooting, and the importance of memorizing the chord shape before advancing in the course.
